Main industry (NACE): 46.500 Engroshandel med informasjons- og kommunikasjonsteknologiutstyr. Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue NOK -441,000; operating result NOK -15,846,000; net result NOK 18,081,000; total assets NOK 822,731,000; equity NOK 622,872,000 (the group statement for the same year reports revenue NOK 1,532,046,000). Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Kurt Østrem; board chair Ingelin Drøpping; 4 other board members. Sub-units registered: 1. Website: www.zaptec.com. The website describes the company as: "Zaptec is a Norwegian EV charging manufacturer. We build user-friendly, reliable, and efficient charging solutions that power adventures."
